risks.title: Cybersecurity and cyber attacks
risks.score_rationale: Risk is frequently mentioned in the 10-K with strong language ("incidents", "prevention, detection, mitigation"). The audit committee and board are actively involved, underscoring strategic importance. Cybersecurity category is critical for financial institutions. Risk is stable versus prior year.

risks.title: Bermuda tax risk
risks.score_rationale: Implementation of 15% taxation in Bermuda starting 2025 represents a major change (explicit language on impact). This risk is new versus prior year, as previously the absence of tax was a structural advantage. Regulatory category is heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Dependence on computer systems
risks.score_rationale: Text emphasizes business continuity plans, backups and secondary data centers. Risk relates to availability of critical systems. Language shows active preparation, but exposure is elevated. Central position in 10-K. Technology category is highly impactful.

risks.title: Management of equity capital
risks.score_rationale: Share repurchase program ($750M) and dependence on board decisions regarding dividends show exposure to capital management risk. Language is measured, but the high repurchase amount underscores importance. Risk stable versus prior year.

risks.title: Legal proceedings
risks.score_rationale: Risk is mentioned by reference to Note 20, without details, suggesting an existing but managed risk. Absence of detailed description indicates moderate intensity. Litigation category is less weighted here. Standard position in 10-K.

ai_positioning.summary: RNR does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. Information provided focuses on the company's financial aspects and investments.
